name: 1913 S. Indiana Avenue — the one-storey frame shed on 1913's alley (district draft; refined by T-1946)

grade.why: Known from maps or written records; no picture of it has been found.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3151 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.250, v -1.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet is tied to sheets 20 and 28 where it meets them (T-3150): 0.67 m RMS over its six control components, with no independent check of its own, plus about a pixel (0.05 m) of trace. Rotation 179.394 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 1913 S. Indiana Avenue, parcel indiana_1913 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Indiana Avenue, the background behind Prairie Avenue: Indiana Avenue's east frontage, 18th to 20th Street, and East Eighteenth Street's row at 213-217 (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 27).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: The census reading 'A 1-storey frame shed (yellow) on the alley': 1 storeys.

construction.note: The trace's fabric colour on the main part: frame.

parts.from: s27wfp-indiana_1913-b2 outline (main, frame), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 89% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s27wfp-indiana_1913-b2 outline (main, frame), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 89% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B behind the stone strip along its Indiana front; the one-storey frame shed on the alley stands as its own building. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1204628674 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-background-3151.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'A 1-storey frame shed (yellow) on the alley'.  Carried to 1904 on the T-3151 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

citations.citation: Sanborn Map Company. Insurance Maps of Chicago, Illinois, Volume 3. New York: Sanborn Map Company, 1911. Sheet 27.
what_it_supplies: Lots, lot lines and the 1911 street numbers of Indiana Avenue's east face from 18th to 20th Street, and the corner lots' East 18th and East 20th Street numbers
Indiana Avenue's two property lines, 18th to 20th, drawn rather than interpolated between sheets 20 and 35
Footprints, material colour, storeys and use of the buildings on those lots as of 1911 (read by T-3151, not here)
what_it_does_not_supply: Anything as of 1904 on its own authority. It is a 1911 survey, and Glessner House's reading that sheets 20, 28 and 35 changed little between 1904 and 1911 was not made of this sheet
A construction date for any building it draws
Elevations, grades, curb heights or fill depths -- no Sanborn sheet carries a level
Architecture above the footprint beyond its story count, material colour and roof symbol
Michigan Avenue and its lots, which it draws but nothing here reads yet

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3151, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 27w trace (s27wfp-indiana_1913-b2), the T-3151 census (s27w-1913-shed) and the T-1837 register row frontage-27w-1913; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3151).
